result.title: LawKAN: Group-Law Layers for Composition -- When Imposing a Known Law Pays Off
result.comment: 20 pages main text (53 total), 15 figures, 6 tables in main text (31 incl. appendices). Code: https://github.com/occamolab/lawkan
result.summary: Many tasks compose transformations by a known rule: chained rotations in robotics and navigation. Learned models relearn it, compounding error; classical estimators hardcode it and miss hardware deviations. We impose the known structure and learn only the remainder: an exact non-commutative group law sits in the node of a self-contained layer, its edges learn local increments, and a zero-initialized correction psi learns unknown deviations of the law. A pre-training criterion predicts exact representability. On fixed-angle SU(2) composition, a 54-parameter dense edge is the most accurate dense model, at 27x fewer parameters than the strongest fixed-matrix baseline, and lies 0.05 deg above the Bayes floor. On real robot arms, an isolated 306-parameter psi reaches 1.12-1.14 mm versus 1.29-1.33 mm for Gauss-Newton at N >= 60, and the recipe transfers across three vendors and two protocols. The recipe matches classical fits where the data obey the law and loses where the imposed law is not the task's.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LawKAN：把精确的非交换群合成律硬编码进一个自包含层的节点，由边学习局部增量，并用零初始化的修正项 psi 吸收定律之外的硬件偏差；在 SU(2) 定角旋转合成与真实机械臂上验证参数效率与精度，并给出预训练可表示性判据。
AI.relevance_reason: 「已知合成律 + 可学习局部增量 + 零初始化残差修正」这一结构可能为 LVR 中多步空间变换的 latent 状态更新提供线索：如何在保持几何一致性的同时容纳真实偏差，并抑制链式复合的误差累积，但需核查其向视觉推理状态的迁移性。
